subject: R+INLA via the software modules mechanism.

messages.author: 874186cf4f5d41df
messages.subject: R+INLA via the software modules mechanism.
parts:
Hi,
I want to use INLA in HPC. For this  r+inla is available via the software modules mechanism.  After   loading r+inla module, the module list shows both - singularity/2.5.1 and  r+inla.  
eg:
 $ module load r+inla
 $ rinla
Mounting collections associated with user

==================================================
 R + INLA Container

Built from an Ubuntu 18.04 Docker image.
These packages (and dep's) have been added:
R-3.4.4 + INLA as at 2018-07-12

Singularity > R
+===========
My question is how to modify my qsub file to run a R script in batch model in cluster.  For  other R versions I use;
 module load R/3.5.0 
R CMD BATCH myRscript.R

Thanks in advance,
Ravi

I don't know; I have no experience with software module
mechanism/containers...

the default build for the Linux binary is Ubuntu 18.04, so the binary
should run fine.

H
